findings.title: Server hung for 120.00s and was killed by the watchdog
findings.summary: One server tick took 120.00 seconds (the limit is 60). The watchdog then killed the JVM, so this report shows *where it was stuck*, not what threw. Read the top frames to find the blocked code path -- a mod doing synchronous IO, a huge chunk operation, or a deadlock.
findings.explanation: One server tick took 120.00 seconds (the limit is 60). The watchdog then killed the JVM, so this report shows *where it was stuck*, not what threw. Read the top frames to find the blocked code path -- a mod doing synchronous IO, a huge chunk operation, or a deadlock.
fixes: Look at the top stack frames below -- the first non-vanilla class is usually the culprit.
If it happens during chunk saving, treat it as a memory problem (see oom.save-time).
As a last resort only: `-Dfml.watchdogKillTimeout=180` buys time but hides the cause.

findings.title: lithium crashed at runtime
findings.summary: The failing code path runs through lithium (attribution confidence 97%). The exception itself is generic, but the stack points at this mod's classes.
findings.explanation: The failing code path runs through lithium (attribution confidence 97%). The exception itself is generic, but the stack points at this mod's classes.
fixes: Update lithium to the latest build for 1.20.1 -- runtime NPEs/ISEs like this are usually fixed quickly.
If it is already up to date, report this crash report to the mod's issue tracker.
As a workaround, remove lithium and anything that depends on it.
